notes.title: Free DLC & Updates & Info
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43763883/838eab40868904c281d7f3404749cc785ea33fbd.png[/img]
[b]Steam Puzzle Fest is Here[/b]
I Know its kinda late but Steam puzzle fest is now live that's mean you should be able to download new update and claim free DLC from store.

[b]DLC[/b]
DLC contain 12 extra levels with different difficulties 
12 new Arts + 1 new background

[b]Updates/Fixes[/b]
Helping puzzle are much darker now and its easier to see what is puzzle and what is helping puzzle. 
New button on Main Menu that will get you to new DLC content .
Some extra fixes with gaps and other bugs.


[b]Info[/b]
Thanks for supporting the game and me as well. I wasn't thinking that I would get that much support. Sadly I think that will be the last major update for that game, probably next updates will be just small bug fixes. I have plans for a few more games not only puzzles but first person horror game and 2d rpg but the way to that is still long. I can say that a horror game should be ready to launch around june as a new puzzle game.
Thank you all <3

[b]Game will be on discount on the last days of the event[/b]

notes.title: Free DLC - Steam Puzzle Fest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43763883/838eab40868904c281d7f3404749cc785ea33fbd.png[/img]

[b]Steam Puzzle Fest[/b]
Hentai Puzzle Quest will participate in a steam puzzle fest and this is in my opinion the best time to add free dlc with some content in it. With the start of the steam puzzle fest there will be a free dlc.

DLC will have a separate store page so you will need to claim it from there.

[b]Updates/Fixes[/b]
Some extra fixes with gaps and other bugs.
few graphics where changed in store

More info when the event will be on.

notes.title: Update & DLC & Info
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43763883/6a0ebbfcaf0ebc2f3f3483f8fd64c8100fdbbecd.png[/img]
[b]Thank you & Info[/b]
To be honest I was and I am still surprised that someone wishlisted this game, everyday people are adding this game to their wishlist and I want to thank you. This is why I'm adding 6 levels with higher quality arts and some "lower" quality arts where changed by higher quality ones.

[b]DLC[/b]
Due to wishlist popularity I have plans to add a free dlc with extra 12-18 levels.
DLC should be available in less than 1 month after game release.
